items.rationale: TRIM removes the leading and trailing spaces and reduces the three spaces between the words to one, leaving Kisumu town, which has 6 + 1 + 4 = 11 characters.
The trailing space is a real character, so the cell holds 8 characters and the text is different from the 7-character Nairobi. Excel ignores case but not spaces.
TRIM keeps one space between words and removes the extra ones. It does not remove every space, and it does not give an error.
The typed text has 2 + 7 + 2 = 11 characters and the trimmed text has 7, so the difference, the number of spaces TRIM removed, is 4.
